design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is dichotomous item scoring (correct/incorrect) derived from human ratings, not PV-based achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but makes no mention of whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses models that do not account for school clustering, focusing instead on individual student-level analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through cross-validation and bootstrapping, with no mention of validation on external datasets.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “We tested various combinations… on responses to reading comprehension items from the 2015 German PISA assessment.” (Germany only; no separate per-country/system analyses reported.)
